$comment: D-MIR-ASM-BY-ADDRESS-OPERAND-BOUND-TO-A-REGISTER-RECEIVES-ITS-ADDRESS and D-ASM-MULTI-REGISTER-OPERAND-BINDING-NOT-REALIZED, aarch64. A struct, a `_Complex`, an `__int128` or a binary128 `long double` bound to an inline-asm REGISTER constraint must reach the template as its VALUE — loaded into its register(s) before the template, stored back after it — where the template used to receive the value's ADDRESS (`__int128` and `_Complex float` on `"r"`: rc=0, the wrong bits, debug and release) or only its first 8 bytes (a 16-byte struct on `"w"`). A value twice a register wide rides a register PAIR, the second register named `%H0` (the dialect's `pairSecond` letter). Twelve shapes, each its own exit code 11..22: a pair read, written and read-modify-written; a 16-byte struct pair beside register clobbers (the constrained range must hold only its own instructions — a frame address materialized inside it used to be refused at `callconv`, L_SideStructureReferenceLost); a `_Complex double` pair; a `_Complex float` in one register; a 4-byte struct and an `__int128` in SIMD&FP registers; an `asm goto` pair output read on both edges; an RVALUE product as the operand; and, Linux only, a binary128 `long double` on a general-register pair and a `_Complex long double` on a Q-register pair. aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc 13.3.0 runs the file to 42 at -O0 and -O2 under qemu-aarch64 (clang 18.1.3 refuses `%H`). Every check is BITWISE over the value's own bytes, so an address, a half, or swapped halves cannot pass. RED-ON-DISABLE: undo the front end's carriage (hand the operand's address to the register) and the first check fails. On Apple arm64 a `long double` IS a `double`, so the two long-double shapes are compiled out there (`__APPLE__`); the Mach-O arm executes on the macOS leg.
$commentForbidDiagnostics: P69: this example holds a value-returning function whose last statement is not a plain `return` (found by a mechanical scan of the corpus for exactly that shape), so the function is complete only because DSS SEES that control never arrives at its closing brace. Until P69 losing that sight REFUSED the compile. Under C it no longer does: C23 6.9.2p13 accepts a non-void function whose end is reached, so the compile succeeds with the warning H_NonVoidFunctionEndReachable and the program may run unchanged. This key keeps the red: the arm fails when that code is reported, in both runners, where the exit code could not see the regression.
